meta.champion_definition: Best on the held-out test set among the models compared here.

champion_definition: Best on the held-out test set among the models compared here.
disclosure: Rules were written after inspecting DistilBERT test errors (adaptive reuse of the test set). No manual validation was performed. Counts are assigned after earlier rules claim matching reviews (priority order).
chart_subtitle: Dual-model comparison of discrete error counts. Indigo: DeBERTa-v3-Omni (n = 1,382 errors, primary); Grey: DistilBERT 281k (n = 1,901 errors, comparison).
chart_footer_note: Card chip n = 1,382 reflects primary DeBERTa error population. Grey bars reflect DistilBERT errors (n = 1,901).

categories.label: Mixed / Contrastive Clauses ('good, but...')
categories.description: Reviews containing contrasting conjunctions (but, however, although, though, yet, etc.). The rule is broad and also applies to many correctly classified reviews.
categories.comparative_note: DeBERTa has 1,001 errors against 1,367 for DistilBERT in this category (raw text, amazon_test, n = 72,846). Overall test errors fell from 1,901 to 1,382 (-27.3%); this category: -26.8% (-366 errors). Not an ablation; model differences are bundled.

categories.label: Indirect & Nuanced Sentiment (Residual)
categories.description: Subtle dissatisfaction expressed through nuance, qualified statements, or absence of overt negation keywords.
categories.comparative_note: DeBERTa has 247 errors against 340 for DistilBERT in this category (raw text, amazon_test, n = 72,846). Overall test errors fell from 1,901 to 1,382 (-27.3%); this category: -27.4% (-93 errors). Not an ablation; model differences are bundled.

categories.label: Subtle Packaging/Transit Complaints
categories.description: Complaints focused on outer shipping boxes, broken inner seals, crushed packaging, or logistics transit damage.
categories.comparative_note: DeBERTa has 79 errors against 101 for DistilBERT in this category (raw text, amazon_test, n = 72,846). Overall test errors fell from 1,901 to 1,382 (-27.3%); this category: -21.8% (-22 errors). Not an ablation; model differences are bundled.

categories.label: Sequence Truncation Beyond 128 Tokens
categories.description: Long customer reviews spanning 128 or more words where critical sentiment signals may lie beyond the token truncation horizon.
categories.comparative_note: DeBERTa has 22 errors against 36 for DistilBERT in this category (raw text, amazon_test, n = 72,846). Overall test errors fell from 1,901 to 1,382 (-27.3%); this category: -38.9% (-14 errors). Not an ablation; model differences are bundled.

categories.label: Rating-Text Inversion (Label Noise)
categories.description: Reviews where positive praise text is attached to 1-star ratings or vice versa, indicative of user rating error or label noise.
categories.comparative_note: DeBERTa has 18 errors against 25 for DistilBERT in this category (raw text, amazon_test, n = 72,846). Overall test errors fell from 1,901 to 1,382 (-27.3%); this category: -28.0% (-7 errors). Not an ablation; model differences are bundled.

categories.label: Domain-Specific Food Idioms & Jargon
categories.description: Domain-specific food descriptors such as stale, rancid, cardboard, chemical, rubbery, or aftertaste.
categories.comparative_note: DeBERTa has 11 errors against 20 for DistilBERT in this category (raw text, amazon_test, n = 72,846). Overall test errors fell from 1,901 to 1,382 (-27.3%); this category: -45.0% (-9 errors). Not an ablation; model differences are bundled.

categories.label: Sarcasm & Ironic Polarity
categories.description: Ironic polarity, sarcastic praise (e.g. yeah right, thanks for nothing), or expressive punctuation (!?, ?!).
categories.comparative_note: DeBERTa has 4 errors against 12 for DistilBERT in this category (raw text, amazon_test, n = 72,846). Overall test errors fell from 1,901 to 1,382 (-27.3%); this category: -66.7% (-8 errors). Not an ablation; model differences are bundled.

overlap.description: Of DeBERTa's 1,382 errors, 968 are shared with DistilBERT and 414 are new errors where DistilBERT was correct. DeBERTa correctly classifies 933 reviews that DistilBERT failed on, for a net reduction of 519 errors.
